claims.claim_text: Official Army bulk data supports a high-confidence identification of indexed Private First Class Marvin J Reed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army record has the exact indexed name and the same nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from exact full-name and nonshared protected-identifier agreement across two official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record corroborates wartime service but does not establish an immediate pre-OSS affiliation or civilian employer.
